summary: Petrobras filed a 6-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Petrobras Global Finance B.V. delivered redemption notices for its 5.999% Global Notes due 2028, with a September 25, 2026 redemption date. The US$1,080,945,000 principal tranche is being redeemed at approximately US$1,010.601180 per US$1,000, including a make-whole premium of US$10.601180 per US$1,000 (US$11,459,292.52 aggregate), plus accrued interest of US$9.665056 per US$1,000 from July 27, 2026. PGF will fund with cash on hand, extinguishing the notes and Luxembourg listing.
